home.intro.p1: I am a passionate full-stack developer and designer, dedicated to building elegant and high-performance web applications. I have over eight years of development experience since I first started coding. I believe the perfect fusion of technology and aesthetics can create products that truly transform user experiences. In my past career, I have participated in the architectural design and front-end development of multiple large-scale projects, covering various fields such as e-commerce platforms, SaaS products, and open-source tools. I am particularly adept at translating complex business logic into clean and intuitive user interfaces, making technology truly serve people.
home.intro.p2: In terms of the tech stack, I have deep expertise in the modern front-end ecosystem, being proficient in mainstream frameworks and languages like React, Vue, and TypeScript. Meanwhile, I also have a profound understanding and practical experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js and Go. I am enthusiastic about exploring emerging technologies and am currently researching WebGPU, Edge Computing, and AI-driven development tools. I believe an excellent developer should not only master tools but also understand the design philosophies and trade-offs behind them. Code is not just a means to implement functionality; it is an art of expressing ideas.
home.intro.p3: Beyond my day-to-day development work, I am an active participant in the open-source community. I maintain several open-source projects that have gained considerable traction on GitHub, covering UI component libraries, CLI tools, and developer productivity utilities. Open source has taught me how to collaborate with developers worldwide, write maintainable code, and build a healthy community. I frequently share my experiences at tech conferences and regularly write technical articles on my personal blog, covering topics like front-end performance optimization, design system architecture, and software engineering best practices.
home.intro.p4: Outside of work, I am an equally curious person. I love photography, especially urban landscapes and architectural photography—these visual experiences profoundly influence my design aesthetics. I am also a coffee enthusiast, believing that a good cup of pour-over coffee can spark infinite creativity. On weekends, you might find me in an independent cafe, enjoying specialty coffee while brainstorming the next exciting project. I firmly believe that great creations stem from a love for life and a relentless pursuit of detail, whether typing on a keyboard or living everyday life.
about.story.p1: My programming journey began in college, when I was deeply captivated by the magic of the Web upon my first encounter with HTML and CSS. Since then, I have aspired to become a full-stack developer capable of mastering both technology and design. Today, with technology evolving rapidly, I always maintain my passion for learning, continuously exploring the intersection of cutting-edge tech and design trends. From responsive design to micro-frontend architecture, from component-driven development to design systems, I have actively participated in every technological wave and accumulated rich practical experience. I firmly believe that good code should be like elegant prose, possessing both logical rigor and expressive beauty.
about.story.p2: Throughout my career, I have served as a senior front-end engineer and technical lead at several innovative tech companies. I spearheaded the design and implementation of multiple enterprise-grade Design Systems, serving the daily collaboration of hundreds of developers and designers. In terms of performance optimization, using techniques like Code Splitting, lazy loading, and Service Worker strategies, I successfully reduced the LCP of core pages from 4.2 seconds down to 1.1 seconds, achieving a 73% optimization in initial rendering time. These experiences have profoundly taught me that truly excellent products must not only be visually stunning but also push performance and accessibility to the extreme.
about.story.p3: Open source is an indispensable part of my life. I actively maintain several open-source projects on GitHub, including a lightweight React animation library and a suite of command-line tools for developers. Through participation in the open-source community, I have learned how to write clear documentation, handle Pull Requests from contributors worldwide, and carefully weigh the pros and cons of different approaches in technical decisions. The most important lesson open source has taught me is: the value of code lies not in its complexity, but in how many people it helps solve their problems.
about.story.p4: When I'm not writing code, you might find me taking photos in the alleys of the city, using my lens to capture the interplay of light, shadow, and architectural geometry. Photography has trained my observation skills and sensitivity to detail, which in turn profoundly influence my design work. I'm also a fervent coffee lover—from pour-overs to espresso, light to dark roasts, every coffee has a unique flavor story. I believe creativity stems from a nuanced perception of life, whether that is tapping on a keyboard or living out the everyday.
project.aurora.desc: A modern React component library providing 50+ meticulously designed components, supporting dark mode, accessibility, and full TypeScript typings. Adopted by over 200 projects.
project.veloci.desc: A high-performance CLI CI/CD tool written in Go, supporting parallel task execution and intelligent caching strategies. It boosts build speeds by 3x compared to traditional solutions.
project.pixelflow.desc: A WebGL-based real-time image processing engine supporting filter overlays, color adjustments, and layer blending. It delivers near-native image editing experiences in the browser.
project.nexflow.desc: A visual workflow orchestration platform that allows building complex data processing pipelines via drag-and-drop. It features 20+ built-in nodes and supports custom plugin extensions and live data previews.
project.tinymark.desc: A minimalist Markdown editor, zero-config and ready out of the box. Supports live preview, LaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and custom themes. Bundle size is only 28KB.
project.skymetrics.desc: An application performance monitoring platform for developers, providing real-time error tracking, performance metrics analysis, and user behavior insights. Supports Web, Node.js, and React Native.
